title: Validate work-item objects and references
objective: Add sdlc validate --work-item <work-item-id> to validate every object in a work-item directory against its declared schema and verify every reference resolves to an actual object or property.

branch.name: main
branch.rationale: The repository is already on the main branch and the user requested preparation, processing, and per-task commits on the current repository.

request.text:
Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to implement `sdlc validate --work-item <work-item-id>` that validates all objects in the directory according to their declared schemas and also validates that every reference in every document is resolvable and points to an actual object/property. Ensure the tests are thorough and handle cases as documented in the 'sdlc ref validate --ref {ref}' unit tests which should be using dynamic discovery to ensure we've tested all reference types.. Commit the new work item.

Process the new work item, commit per task.

scope.name: work-item-validation-command
scope.description: Add sdlc validate --work-item <work-item-id> as a read-only complete validation command for one work-item artifact tree.
scope.reason: Operators need one boundary that combines declared-schema validation with semantic reference resolution.

scope.name: object-schema-validation
scope.description: Validate work-item.json, every task envelope, and every selected task payload against their declared repository-local schemas.
scope.reason: Object-tree structure and task-specific payload contracts must be checked together.

scope.name: reference-resolution
scope.description: Discover references in every document, validate each reference shape using the dynamic registered reference types, and resolve each reference to an actual object or property in the selected work-item tree.
scope.reason: Syntactic ref validation alone does not prove that referenced objects or properties exist.

scope.name: dynamic-reference-coverage
scope.description: Extend the existing dynamically discovered reference-type test strategy so every marked reference schema example is exercised through the complete work-item validation boundary where applicable.
scope.reason: Future reference types must not be omitted from validation coverage.

nonGoals.name: lifecycle-mutation
nonGoals.description: Do not change work-item or task lifecycle state, processingStatus, task results, or validation records while validating.
nonGoals.reason: The command is a read-only validation boundary.

nonGoals.name: semantic-approval
nonGoals.description: Do not approve, release, execute, repair, or semantically resolve the selected work item beyond checking local reference targets exist.
nonGoals.reason: Reference resolution proves local addressability, not correctness, approval, or production readiness.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-production-runtime
nonGoals.description: Do not add provider calls, HTTP services, persistence, deployment, or production release behavior.
nonGoals.reason: WI-0013 is limited to local artifact discovery, schema validation, and reference resolution.

items.name: complete-declared-schema-validation
items.description: sdlc validate --work-item <work-item-id> must validate the work-item record, every task envelope, and every selected nested task payload against its declared schema.
items.reason: All objects in the work-item directory must conform to the contract they declare.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A valid complete work item returns zero and reports every discovered object as schema-valid.
A malformed work-item/task/payload object returns actionable per-object findings and a non-zero result.

items.name: reference-target-resolution
items.description: Every reference in every work-item document must be validated against supported reference schemas and resolved to an actual object or property in the selected work-item tree when its scope is local to that tree.
items.reason: References must identify real objects/properties rather than merely matching a string pattern.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Valid local references such as work-item, task-qualified, task-local, objective, test-case, requirement, and result references resolve to existing documents/properties.
Missing documents, missing properties, malformed selectors, and references outside the selected work-item scope produce actionable findings.

items.name: dynamic-reference-coverage
items.description: Tests must dynamically discover every schema marked x-sdlc-reference-type: true and exercise its root examples through the appropriate validation boundary.
items.reason: The existing sdlc ref validate tests establish a future-proof reference-type discovery convention that complete validation must preserve.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The test suite discovers all marked reference schemas recursively, validates every root example syntactically, and includes resolvable local examples in complete work-item validation fixtures.

items.name: validation-response
items.description: The command must return a closed persisted response schema with object counts, reference counts, validity, per-object findings, and per-reference resolution findings.
items.reason: Automation needs to distinguish schema failures from unresolved references and identify the exact object or reference at fault.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A valid complete work-item response passes the persisted validation response schema and reports zero invalid objects and unresolved references.
